I'm facing a problem working with Arabic diacritics as I'm trying to color the diacritics with different color than the letter itself so, I thought of rich text but I ended up with the results below
As seen in the image in the actual results there are two problems:
1- Diacritics don't stack
2- They clip with the letter 
As opposed to when I use a normal non-rich Text
**Expected results:** <!-- what did you want to see? -->
I'm expecting something like this 
![hI9pJ](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/30890454/103307385-8bcbec80-4a18-11eb-9a06-345debad09ec.png)


**Actual results:** <!-- what did you see? -->
But instead I end up with this 
![diacritic](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/30890454/103307638-3c39f080-4a19-11eb-8464-dcf2edb1a6f1.jpeg)

**Non-rich text:**
![diacritic2](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/30890454/103308234-9a1b0800-4a1a-11eb-873a-21bb950d4630.jpeg)

It works fine when diacritics and letters are in a single Text string but of course I lose the ability to color the diacritics separately which is the main problem here 
## Steps to Reproduce

<!-- You must include full steps to reproduce so that we can reproduce the problem. -->

1. Create a flutter project
2. Run the following code snippet: 

<details>
  <summary>Snippet</summary>


        Scaffold(
         body: Center(
          child: RichText(
           softWrap: true,
           textWidthBasis: TextWidthBasis.longestLine,
           text: TextSpan(children: [
            TextSpan(
              text: "ك",
              style: TextStyle(
                color: Colors.blue,
                fontSize: 48,
                // fontFamily: "simplified-arabic"و
              ),
            ),
            TextSpan(
              text: "ِّ", //Diacritic
              style: TextStyle(
                color: Colors.red,
                fontSize: 48,
                // fontFamily: "simplified-arabic",
              ),
            ),
            TextSpan(
              text: "ـ",
              style: TextStyle(
                color: Colors.blue,
                fontSize: 48,
                // fontFamily: "simplified-arabic",
              ),
            ),
          ]),
         ),
       ),
     );



</details>
